mentions.name: AI bedtime stories app (MVP)
mentions.description: This app generates personalized bedtime stories from user-supplied character names and a theme, then reads them aloud via text-to-speech, including the option to clone a parent's voice for narration. Planned differentiators include connecting stories into a continuous narrative based on previous ones and adapting fairy-tale context to local folklore (e.g., Polish vs. British).
mentions.problem: Existing services like this mostly don't support using a parent's voice, and very few can connect stories together into a continuous narrative based on previous ones.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building an MVP for an "AI bedtime stories" app. The idea is that you just input the character names, a theme, and choose a voice (including the option to clone a parent's voice for narration). It generates a story and reads it out using TTS.
